description: JellyWatching monitors consecutive episode playback per user and device. After a configurable number of episodes, it pauses playback and displays a confirmation message, similar to the Netflix 'Are you still watching?' feature. Supports flexible thresholds, night mode, per-user overrides, and activity detection.
name: JellyWatching
overview: Are you still watching? Pauses playback after consecutive episodes.
